cards.body_en: Newborns lose heat quickly because they have a large surface area and thin skin.
retrieval_hints_en: why do newborns lose heat so quickly
why is it dangerous if baby is not dried and wrapped immediately

cards.body_en: Dry the baby immediately and wrap with a warm cloth covering the head.
Skin-to-skin contact is the first step to re-warm a hypothermic newborn.

queries.query: The baby's head is uncovered in a cold room and the baby was not dried immediately. Why do newborns lose heat so quickly?
